name: Tama
source:
A cat suit that appears in both [I][url=/v1299]428: Shibuya Scramble[/url][/I] and [I][url=/v10856]Time Travelers[/url][/I]. In both games, the suit is inhabited by an unidentified female character.

In [I][url=/v1299]428: Shibuya Scramble[/url][/I]:
Tama, a person of unknown identity, is working inside a cat suit as a by-the-day temp worker for [url=/c74644]Yanagishita[/url] in order to buy a special necklace she found at a general store. She begins her work of promoting a diet drink, "Burning Hammer."
[Edited from [url=https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/428:_Shibuya_Scramble]Wikipedia[/url]]
[spoiler]Her true identity is revealed to be [url=/c129945]Maria Osawa[/url], [url=/c73545]Hitomi[/url]'s twin sister and [url=/c73542]Kenji Osawa[/url]'s daughter.

The Tama mascot also appear as:
—One of [url=/c93380]Sasayama[/url]'s disguises in a Bad Ending, where it's revealed that the costume is a CATS (Costume As Transmission System), a robotic suit capable of dimensional travel.
—Several guides within the Labyrinth that lead [url=/c73543]Minorikawa[/url] through it.[/spoiler]

In [I][url=/v10856]Time Travelers[/url][/I]:
A mysterious woman who appears in the story wearing a cat costume. Her identity is a mystery.
[spoiler]Tama's real identity is an iteration of [url=/c74218]Mikoto Shindou[/url], from one of her many time loops in the story.[/spoiler]
